hint.1: Explore the village plaza. Roads between houses lead to seals and side quests.
hint.2: The canyon forks. Wait for the ram to charge along its red tell, then hit while stunned.
hint.3: Explore the harbour piers and ship. Dash to reflect the plants' shots.
hint.4: Bats dive through the grove. Find seals, clear the arena and open the cage.
hint.5: Armoured turtles patrol the windmill workshops. Ground slam to break their armour.
hint.6: Allow room to stop on the frozen lake. Explore the side terraces.
hint.7: Activate ruin seals in the map's 1 → 2 → 3 order. Watch suspicious crates!
hint.8: Watch the floating eyes around the wind towers; reflecting their shots is safer.
hint.9: Ember fortress roads connect broad courtyards. Find the exploration and arena stars.
hint.10: Power the seals in both castle wings, complete side quests and face the guardian.
